ME
a little about me

I'm Keya, a third-year BTech student majoring in Data Science. I'm an avid learner who's always up for exploring something new — whether that's a subject, a place, or an idea. Outside academics, I love travelling; a recent trip to the United States only made me more eager to see the rest of the world. I'm always up for a coffee and a good conversation, and I genuinely enjoy helping people think through problems and find solutions.
